spectators.label: Tai chi grandma with a red fan
spectators.look: small slender grandmother with white hair in a tight bun held by a green jade hairpin and a warm wrinkled smile, wearing a lilac silk tai chi suit with white knot buttons and black slippers, holding a red folding fan
spectators.idle: slow graceful tai chi pose, fan held closed
spectators.cheer: fan snapped open high above her head
spectators.shocked: open fan covering her mouth, eyes wide

spectators.label: Grumpy old man with a cane
spectators.look: hunched grumpy old man, bald on top with fluffy white side tufts and huge bushy white eyebrows over a permanent scowl, wearing a brown knit cardigan over a beige shirt with a green bow tie and grey slacks, leaning on a crooked wooden cane
spectators.idle: both hands stacked on the cane, scowling
spectators.cheer: shaking the cane in the air, yelling
spectators.shocked: eyebrows shot up, false teeth popping out of his open mouth

spectators.label: Elegant lady with a lace parasol
spectators.look: elegant elderly lady with silver curled hair, a long pearl necklace and a refined smile, wearing a long lavender dress with a white lace collar and white gloves, holding a folded white lace parasol
spectators.idle: both hands resting on the folded parasol, poised
spectators.cheer: parasol raised and waved, laughing politely
spectators.shocked: gloved hand at her pearls, gasping

spectators.label: Retired general with a monocle
spectators.look: tall ramrod-straight old man with a huge white walrus mustache and a monocle, wearing a peaked olive cap and an olive military-style dress jacket with gold buttons and rows of colorful ribbon bars, polished black boots
spectators.idle: hands clasped behind his back, chin raised
spectators.cheer: cap raised high in one hand held out to the side, harrumphing loudly

spectators.label: Fisherman grandpa
spectators.look: weathered old fisherman with deep-tan skin, white stubble and squinting eyes under a frayed straw hat, wearing a rolled-sleeve faded blue work shirt, grey trousers tucked into black rubber boots, holding a dried fish on a skewer
spectators.idle: chewing on the dried fish skewer, watching
spectators.shocked: fish skewer dangling from his open mouth

spectators.label: Knitting granny
spectators.look: plump little granny with grey curls under a red headscarf and round wire glasses, wearing a mossy-green shawl over a brown dress, holding knitting needles with a half-finished bright yellow scarf
spectators.idle: knitting without looking down, eyes on the ring
spectators.shocked: yarn ball dropping and unrolling, glasses slipping

spectators.label: Bonsai gardener grandpa
spectators.look: tiny bent-over old man with a long thin white goatee and tiny round spectacles, wearing an indigo work jacket and loose indigo trousers with wooden sandals, cradling a small potted bonsai pine
spectators.idle: carefully cradling the bonsai, squinting at the ring
spectators.shocked: hugging the bonsai protectively, spectacles flying

spectators.label: Old rocker with tinted glasses
spectators.look: lanky old rocker with a long grey ponytail, a grey goatee and round purple-tinted sunglasses, wearing a worn black leather jacket covered in plain round patches, a faded red tee, ripped jeans and cowboy boots
spectators.idle: nodding along, thumbs hooked in his belt loops
spectators.cheer: wild air-guitar windmill with one arm up
spectators.shocked: sunglasses slid down his nose, eyes bulging

spectators.label: Picnic grandma
spectators.look: tiny round grandma with white hair in two small side buns and rosy apple cheeks, wearing a navy kimono under a bright orange apron, carrying a wicker picnic basket full of rice balls
spectators.idle: offering a rice ball from the basket, smiling
spectators.cheer: rice ball held up high, cheering
spectators.shocked: rice balls bouncing out of the tilted basket

spectators.label: Old-time strongman
spectators.look: barrel-chested old strongman, bald with a huge curled white handlebar mustache, wearing a red-and-white striped one-piece strongman suit under an open long brown coat, holding a small round-weighted dumbbell
spectators.idle: curling the little dumbbell, admiring his arm
spectators.cheer: dumbbell held out to the side, other arm flexed
spectators.shocked: mustache drooping, dumbbell dropped on his foot

spectators.label: Absent-minded old professor
spectators.look: thin old professor with a shiny bald dome ringed by two puffs of frizzy white hair, thick round glasses that magnify his eyes and a small pointed white goatee, wearing a rumpled white lab coat over a teal sweater vest and brown slacks, holding a clipboard and a pencil
spectators.idle: scribbling notes on the clipboard, glancing up at the ring
spectators.shocked: hair puffs standing straight up, pencil snapped

spectators.label: Tea lady in a crane kimono
spectators.look: dignified elderly woman with silver hair in an elaborate bun held by a red lacquer comb, wearing a dark-purple kimono printed with white cranes and a gold obi sash, holding a teacup on a saucer
spectators.cheer: teacup raised in a toast, smiling broadly
spectators.shocked: tea splashing out of the cup, eyes wide

spectators.label: Elderly radish farmer
spectators.look: sun-browned elderly farmer with a toothless grin and a white towel around his neck, wearing a wide conical straw hat, a faded green tunic, rolled brown trousers and straw sandals, carrying a basket of giant white radishes on his back
spectators.idle: leaning forward with a hand on his knee, grinning
spectators.shocked: hat pushed up, radishes sliding out of the basket

spectators.label: Cat-eye glasses lady with a fat cat
spectators.look: sassy old lady with tight purple-rinsed curls and pointed cat-eye glasses on a beaded chain, wearing a leopard-print coat and gold earrings, holding a fat orange tabby cat in her arms
spectators.cheer: lifting the cat up, both looking excited
spectators.shocked: glasses flying off, the cat puffed up with fur on end

spectators.label: Ancient village elder in a grass cape
spectators.look: extremely old hunched man with long white hair and a beard reaching his knees, tiny eyes under a wide round straw hat, wearing a shaggy cape of dried straw over a brown robe, holding a twisted staff taller than himself
spectators.idle: leaning on the staff, peering through his beard
spectators.cheer: staff lifted with surprising energy, beard swinging
spectators.shocked: straw cape bristling outward, hat tipping back
